answer.explanation: The live configuration of all four functions matches the IaC template: memory, timeout and environment variables are identical, and no reserved concurrency is set. The most recent LastModified timestamps (01:28:47 for CrudApi, 01:04:35 for Compression, earlier for the others) all fall before the window, so no configuration change happened inside it. Logs for 01:38:51 to 01:48:51 show only normal REPORT lines: max memory used is 90-106 MB against limits of 256 or 1024 MB, and durations are 26-670 ms against timeouts of 10-60 s. A search for error, exception, timeout, denied, forbidden, unauthorized, killed, traceback and warn messages in the window returned no results, so there is no sign of an IAM denial or a timeout.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >
  Benchmark application for the thesis "Cross-Layer Context for LLM-Based Detection and
  Root-Cause Analysis of Configuration Anomalies in AWS Lambda". Four SeBS functions
  (Table 3.2). This template is the intended state of the application.

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Architectures: [x86_64]
    Tracing: PassThrough
    LoggingConfig:
      LogFormat: Text

Resources:
  # --------

input.query_string: fields @timestamp, @logStream, @message | filter @message like /(?i)(error|exception|denied|timeout|task timed out|memory|Unauthorized|Forbidden)/ | sort @timestamp asc | limit 100

fields @timestamp, @logStream, @message | filter @message not like /^REPORT/ and @message not like /^START/ and @message not like /^END/ | filter @message like /(?i)(error|exception|denied|timed out|timeout|forbidden|unauthorized|killed|Traceback|warn)/ | sort @timestamp asc | limit 100
